items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: And he was on the opposite stand for about a week or so.

ctx.x: Rudy Wiedoft was a saxophone player, one of the original saxophone players, I'll put it that way, because he was way back, 1913, '14, '15, those days, you know. And he was on the opposite stand for about a week or so. And lo and behold, the featured singer was an opera star. That's the type of thing it was. And of course the band couldn't play her music because it was all for flutes and oboes and violins, and she brought her music. So she said, 'Well, what are we going to do?'
